verdict.line: You lose if you facetank his extended combos and let Darkness Rises stacks and the Indestructible (W) shield pile up in his favor; you win if you burst a full Facebreaker (E) sandwich before he can convert that damage into shield.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane (48.9% Sett win rate over 571 games, versus 49.8% for Sett overall) that is decided by trade duration rather than raw stats. Short, decisive trades favor Sett because his Grit resource and Facebreaker (E) stun land before Mordekaiser can profit; long trades favor Mordekaiser because Indestructible (W) turns your damage into his shield and Darkness Rises rewards him for staying in extended contact. Whoever controls how long each exchange lasts controls the lane.

theirWindow.what: Once he pulls you in, he'll layer Obliterate (Q) and pop Indestructible (W) while stacking his passive toward the free empowered hit. Don't stand in it hoping to out-trade — back off and let the shield expire before committing again.

yourWindow.when: your Grit bar (P) is near full
yourWindow.what: All-in immediately: empowered Haymaker auto into a centered Facebreaker (E) so he's sandwiched between both fists for the stun. That burst window closes fast once his shield is up, so commit before he can react.

start.why: 50.8% win rate over 632 games as the dominant start (81.1% pick); the sustain and early damage let you win the short hit-and-run trades this lane is built around.

boots.why: 51.2% win rate over 418 games and the majority pick (60.1%); the magic resist blunts Obliterate (Q) and the bonus damage from a proc'd Darkness Rises stack.

core.why: Part of the top build path (55.9% win rate, 127 games); the slow lets you actually stick a Facebreaker (E) sandwich instead of chasing a kited-out Mordekaiser.
Armor shred cuts through his stacked HP and Indestructible (W) shield so your all-in windows actually kill instead of just poking.
Health and omnivamp let you win the sustain race if a trade runs longer than planned, closing the gap on his shield-based healing.

situational.when: he's building toward burst or you expect a forced 1v1 inside Realm of Death (R)
he's stacking HP items and raw shield/health scaling is outpacing your flat damage
you're ahead and want faster Facebreaker (E) and Haymaker resets to keep pressuring
you need to consistently disengage after pokes to deny his Darkness Rises stacks

runes.keystoneWhy: 53.7% win rate over the higher-performing page; Conqueror stacks during your Grit-fueled pokes and converts to omnivamp at max stacks, which is exactly what you need to outlast Indestructible (W) sustain in a trade that runs long.

summoners.why: 50.3% win rate and the overwhelming pick (92.6%); Ignite cuts into whatever health he converts from Indestructible (W) or item sustain, letting your Facebreaker (E) all-in actually secure the kill instead of leaving him topped off.

playing.title: Deny his passive with hit-and-run
playing.detail: Poke with an empowered Knuckle Down auto then step out of Obliterate (Q) range rather than facetanking — standing in extended contact lets Darkness Rises reach its free empowered hit.

playing.title: Land Facebreaker (E) centered
playing.detail: Catching him between both fists doubles the hit and stuns; time this with a full Grit bar so the empowered Haymaker auto lands in the same window before he can react.

playing.title: Track Death's Grip (E) cooldown
playing.detail: Early levels this pull has a long cooldown — stay outside his pull range while it's up, and punish hard the moment it's down since he loses his main engage tool.

playing.title: Force fights before level 6
playing.detail: Without Realm of Death (R), Mordekaiser has no way to banish you into a forced 1v1 — trades favor you more heavily here than at any later point in lane.

playing.title: Don't dump damage into an active shield
playing.detail: Indestructible (W) converts the damage you deal into more shield for him, so bait it out with a weak poke first and save your real combo for after it drops.

playing.title: Shred his HP stacking with Black Cleaver
playing.detail: His shield and health scale hard over time, so the armor shred is what turns your damage from tickling into actually threatening kills in a prolonged fight.

playing.title: Save Ignite for the all-in, not the poke
playing.detail: Hold it until you commit to a full Facebreaker (E) combo — it denies his shield-based healing exactly when you need the extra damage to close out the kill.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and summoner spells reflect measured games on the current patch (571 games at 48.9% win rate for Sett vs Mordekaiser); the trade-timing, ability tells, and combo sequencing are my own reading of the matchup, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Try to hit and run often to prevent Mordekaiser from activating his (P). Try to hit him at the center part of [W] when dealing damage.
